explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because downstream priority ordering cannot preserve upstream provenance order: every observed priority has upstream_rank 0. The supplied upstream source shows assemble_provenance builds evidence_sources with record_id set to source_id (for example s01) instead of preserving the demand record_id (for example n06-r01). Job 2 then receives evidence_sources keyed by s01..s08 while coverage rows are keyed by n06-r01..n06-r08, so prioritize cannot match ranks to needs. The supported localization is therefore the upstream assemble_provenance function, not the downstream ranking function.
cited_evidence: Behavioral criteria require preserving record_id/source provenance and ranking unsupported needs first while preserving upstream provenance order.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01..s08, while Job 2 input needs contains record_id values n06-r01..n06-r08.
Observed Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for all eight records, demonstrating provenance ranks were not matched to need records.

Upstream source for assemble_provenance appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': ..., 'rank': index}, replacing the demand record identity with the source identity.
